mall_profile_summary.name: Cenomi Mall
mall_profile_summary.tagline: A premier shopping and entertainment destination on King Fahd Road with over 350 stores, world-class dining, VOX Cinemas, and family entertainment.

key_zones.North Wing (Ground): Fashion and lifestyle — Zara, H&M, Nike, Starbucks
key_zones.East Wing (Ground): Beauty and jewelry — Sephora, L'azurde, Pandora, Bath & Body Works
key_zones.West Wing (First): Kids and home — Mothercare, Pottery Barn
key_zones.Food Court (Second): 30+ dining options — Al Romansiah, Cheesecake Factory, Shake Shack, Baskin-Robbins
key_zones.Entertainment Zone (Third): VOX Cinemas (12 screens), Billy Beez, KidZania

highlights: VOX Cinemas with IMAX, 4DX, Gold, and Kids screens
Cenomi Rewards loyalty program with 200+ participating stores
Free WiFi, valet parking, prayer rooms on every floor
Family rooms with baby changing on First floor

hours.note: Entertainment zone open until midnight on weekends. Starbucks opens at 07:00.

parking.rate: Free for first 4 hours, 10 SAR/hour after
parking.valet: Available at Main Entrance and South Entrance (30 SAR, free for Gold/Platinum members)

accessibility: Accessible elevators and restrooms on every floor
Free wheelchair and stroller loans from Information Desk

essential_services.information_desk: Ground floor, immediately inside Main Entrance — directions, lost & found, wheelchair/stroller loans
essential_services.prayer_rooms: Ground floor (West Wing) and Second floor (near Food Court) — separate areas for men and women
essential_services.family_room: First floor, West Wing — baby changing, nursing room

active_promotions: Zara End of Season Sale — up to 50% off winter collection (until Mar 20)
Sephora Spring Beauty Sale — up to 20% off selected skincare & fragrance (Mar 15–31)
VOX Cinema Combo Deal — free combo with 2 Standard tickets on weekdays (until Apr 30)
upcoming_events: Spring Fashion Week — Mar 15–22, runway shows at Central Atrium, free entry
Eid Family Carnival — Mar 31–Apr 5, rides and entertainment in Entertainment Zone

dining.summary: Cenomi Mall offers 30+ dining options from quick bites to premium sit-down restaurants. The main Food Court is on the Second floor. Eataly (premium Italian) is separately located on Second floor West Wing.

entities.name: Al Romansiah
entities.key_note: Private dining available. Near prayer room.

entities.name: The Cheesecake Factory
entities.best_for: families, groups, dessert lovers, indecisive groups (huge menu)
entities.key_note: 250+ menu items. Signature cheesecakes are a must-try.

entities.name: Eataly
entities.location: Second floor, West Wing (separate from Food Court)
entities.best_for: couples, date night, special occasions, food enthusiasts
entities.key_note: Open kitchen, private dining. Italian grocery attached. Top romantic spot.

entities.name: Shake Shack
entities.location: Second floor, Food Court (near Entertainment escalators)
entities.best_for: quick meals, pre/post movie, families with kids, teens
entities.key_note: Ideal before or after VOX Cinemas. Halal Angus beef.

entities.name: Starbucks
entities.location: Ground floor, North Wing (near Main Entrance)
entities.best_for: solo visitors, quick coffee, meeting point, WiFi
entities.key_note: Opens at 7 AM — earliest option. Good starting point.

entities.name: Baskin-Robbins
entities.location: Second floor, Food Court (near Entertainment escalators)
entities.best_for: kids, after-movie treat, quick dessert, budget-friendly
entities.key_note: Near the escalators to Third floor. Birthday cakes available.

semantic_highlights: Quick lunch: Shake Shack (20 min) or Starbucks (15 min)
Romantic dinner: Eataly (private dining, open kitchen)
Family dining: Al Romansiah (Saudi, private dining) or Cheesecake Factory (huge menu)
Post-movie treat: Baskin-Robbins (10 min, near cinema escalators)
Dessert: Cheesecake Factory cheesecakes or Baskin-Robbins ice cream
concierge_tips: For pre-movie meals, recommend Shake Shack — fast enough to fit before a showtime
For undecided groups, Cheesecake Factory works because the menu has something for everyone
Al Romansiah is near the prayer room — mention this for families during prayer times
Eataly is separate from the Food Court — guide couples there for a quieter experience

gift.summary: The East Wing on the Ground floor is Cenomi Mall's gift corridor — L'azurde (fine jewelry), Sephora (beauty), Pandora (charm jewelry), and Bath & Body Works (home fragrance) are all within walking distance of each other.

entities.name: L'azurde
entities.key_note: Saudi brand. Engraving and custom designs. Bridal collection.

entities.name: Sephora
entities.key_note: Pre-made gift sets. Beauty advisor service. Spring Sale active (20% off).

entities.name: Pandora
entities.key_note: Charm customization. More accessible than fine jewelry. Quick to shop.

entities.name: Bath & Body Works
entities.key_note: Ready-wrapped gift sets. Mix-and-match deals. Seasonal collections.

entities.name: Apple Store
entities.best_for: husband, tech lover, teen, corporate gift
entities.key_note: AirPods for quick gift. Engraving available. Trade-in program.

semantic_highlights: Girlfriend gift: L'azurde (jewelry) > Sephora (beauty) > Pandora (charms)
Wife gift: L'azurde (premium jewelry) or Sephora (luxury skincare)
Last-minute gift: Sephora gift sets, Pandora (quick pick), Bath & Body Works (ready-wrapped)
Budget gift: Bath & Body Works or Pandora
Tech gift: Apple Store (AirPods, accessories)
Gift corridor path: L'azurde → Pandora → Sephora → Bath & Body Works (all East Wing Ground floor)
concierge_tips: The East Wing is the gift express corridor — all key gift stores within 2-minute walk
For undecided gift buyers, start at Sephora (fragrance sampling helps narrow down)
Mention engraving/personalization at L'azurde and Pandora for extra thoughtfulness
Bath & Body Works is the best fallback for any budget — ready-wrapped sets need no wrapping

family.summary: Cenomi Mall is built for families. The First floor West Wing has kids and family stores (Mothercare, Family Room). The Third floor Entertainment Zone has Billy Beez, KidZania, and VOX Cinemas with a Kids screen.

entities.name: Mothercare
entities.best_for: baby essentials, children's clothing, new parents
entities.key_note: Near Family Room. Car seat fitting service. Baby registry.

entities.name: Billy Beez
entities.best_for: kids play (ages 2-12), supervised activity, burn energy
entities.key_note: Supervised play area. 1-2 hour sessions. Parents can shop while kids play.

entities.name: KidZania
entities.best_for: role-play experiences (ages 4-14), educational fun, longer activity
entities.key_note: 2-4 hour experience. Kids try real-world jobs. Highly supervised.

entities.name: VOX Cinemas (Kids screen)
entities.best_for: family movies, animated films, gentle cinema experience
entities.key_note: Dedicated kids auditorium. Currently showing Cosmic Explorers (G-rated).

semantic_highlights: Kids drop-off: Billy Beez (1-2 hrs) or KidZania (2-4 hrs) while parents shop
Family movie: Cosmic Explorers on Kids screen
Baby essentials: Mothercare (near Family Room for nursing/changing)
Family dining: Al Romansiah (kids menu, private dining) or Shake Shack (quick, milkshakes)
After-activity treat: Baskin-Robbins (near Entertainment escalators)
concierge_tips: Mention the Family Room (First floor, West Wing) proactively for parents with infants
Billy Beez for active play, KidZania for educational experiences — ask about kids' ages
Suggest Baskin-Robbins as a meeting point after kids' activities
Free stroller loans from Information Desk — mention early in the conversation

movie.summary: VOX Cinemas on the Third floor is a 12-screen multiplex with IMAX, 4DX, Gold (luxury), VIP, and Kids formats. Three movies currently showing.

entities.name: Desert Kingdoms
entities.key_note: New release. IMAX recommended for the best experience.

entities.name: Starlight Romance
entities.key_note: New release. Gold screen for a luxury date night experience.

entities.name: Cosmic Explorers
entities.key_note: Kids screen available for a gentler experience.

semantic_highlights: Date night: Starlight Romance on Gold screen → Eataly dinner
Family: Cosmic Explorers on Kids screen → Shake Shack → Baskin-Robbins
Blockbuster: Desert Kingdoms on IMAX for the best experience
Weekday deal: 2 Standard tickets + free combo (popcorn + 2 drinks)
concierge_tips: Gold screens are the premium couples option — suggest for date nights
Kids screen has softer sound and lighting — best for young children
Shake Shack on Second floor is 5 minutes from cinema — perfect pre-movie meal
Suggest Baskin-Robbins after the movie as a sweet ending
Weekday combo deal adds great value — mention it for budget-conscious visitors

quick_visit.summary: For visitors with limited time, Cenomi Mall's Ground floor and Second floor Food Court offer the fastest experiences. Most quick options are near the Main Entrance.
semantic_highlights: Fastest meal: Baskin-Robbins (10 min) or Starbucks (15 min)
Fastest gift: Bath & Body Works gift set (10 min) or Sephora set (15 min)
Quick lunch: Shake Shack (20 min)
concierge_tips: Direct quick visitors to the Ground floor — most accessible from Main Entrance
For food, Second floor Food Court has the highest concentration of quick options
Mention exact floor and zone so they can navigate directly

services.summary: Cenomi Mall provides comprehensive visitor services including information desk, valet, prayer rooms, family facilities, and accessibility support.

entities.name: Information Desk
entities.location: Ground floor, North Wing (inside Main Entrance)
entities.services: Directions, lost & found, wheelchair/stroller loans, general help

entities.name: Prayer Rooms
entities.locations: Ground floor (West Wing) and Second floor (near Food Court)
entities.note: Separate areas for men and women, ablution facilities

entities.name: Family Room
entities.services: Baby changing, nursing room, child rest area

concierge_tips: Proactively mention prayer rooms for visitors during prayer times
Mention Family Room for parents with infants without being asked
Lost & Found is at the Information Desk — mention if someone seems distressed
Wheelchair and stroller loans are free — useful proactive mention for elderly or families

Browse jewelry (L'azurde/Pandora) → Dinner (Eataly) → Movie (Gold screen, Starlight Romance)

playbooks.trigger: gift for girlfriend, present for her
playbooks.approach: L'azurde (premium) > Sephora (beauty) > Pandora (accessible) — all in East Wing gift corridor

playbooks.trigger: movie and food, dinner and movie
playbooks.approach: Shake Shack before → Movie → Baskin-Robbins after. Couples: Eataly → Gold screen.

playbooks.trigger: quick meal, in a hurry, fast food
playbooks.approach: Shake Shack (20 min) or Starbucks (15 min) or Baskin-Robbins (10 min)
H&M + Zara sale → Shake Shack → Free events. Mention: free parking 4 hrs, Cenomi Rewards.
L'azurde → Sephora → Apple Store → Eataly dinner. Mention valet, VIP cinema.
East Wing express: Sephora gift sets → Pandora → Bath & Body Works (all Ground floor)
L'azurde jewelry → Eataly private dining → VOX Gold screen
Cosmic Explorers (Kids screen) → Shake Shack (before) → Baskin-Robbins (after)
Shopping first → Baskin-Robbins or Cheesecake Factory cheesecake as reward

playbooks.trigger: kids play, drop off kids, parents shop
playbooks.approach: Kids: Billy Beez (1-2 hrs) or KidZania (2-4 hrs). Parents shop freely. Meet at Baskin-Robbins.

contextual_reasoning_hints: When a user mentions a specific floor, prioritize entities on that floor or adjacent floors
If the user mentions prayer time or prayer room, proactively mention the nearest prayer room
When recommending dining, consider meal time (quick vs. sit-down) based on the conversation context
For gift recommendations, always ask about the recipient if not specified — gender, age, interests, budget
If a user seems to be a tourist, mention currency exchange, WiFi, and prayer room locations proactively
When suggesting a movie, consider the user's group composition — families get PG options, couples get Gold screen suggestions
Current promotions and offers should be mentioned when relevant — they add value and show awareness
The East Wing is the gift corridor — create walking paths there for gift shoppers
The Food Court to Entertainment Zone transition (Second → Third floor) is natural — use it for movie + food plans
For budget-conscious visitors, mention free parking (first 4 hours), current sales, and Cenomi Rewards
During Ramadan, mall hours shift to 13:00-02:00 — proactively clarify if a user asks about timing
If a user asks about something the mall doesn't have, honestly say so and suggest the Information Desk or an alternative
Billy Beez and KidZania are supervised — this is important context for parents considering drop-off
Eataly's separate location from the Food Court makes it quieter — use this as a selling point for couples

concierge_guidelines.response_style: Answer first, then elaborate. Be concise but thorough. Use a warm, conversational tone like a knowledgeable friend.
grounding_rules: Always base answers on verified mall information from this context pack
Never invent store names, locations, hours, or prices
If unsure, say so honestly and suggest the Information Desk
Respect cultural context and local customs (prayer times, Ramadan, halal)
Mention specific locations (floor, zone, unit) to help visitors navigate
cultural_notes: Saudi Arabia observes prayer times — be sensitive about timing recommendations
All dining is halal — this can be stated when relevant for international visitors
Friday opening times are later due to Friday prayer — clarify when asked about Friday plans
Ramadan hours are significantly different — always clarify if the visitor is asking during Ramadan
Gender-separated prayer rooms are standard — mention this proactively
do_not: Do not recommend alcohol or non-halal dining (not applicable in SA)
Do not make assumptions about visitor gender or family structure
Do not share personal opinions about brands — present options objectively
Do not provide outdated prices or hours — qualify with 'as of our latest information'
Do not ignore accessibility needs — mention wheelchair access proactively when relevant
